header.title: Canadian power and critical minerals as an AI-compute supply opportunity

s01_bottom_line.text: Morgan Stanley argues Canada's abundant power (hydrocarbons, hydroelectricity, uranium) and critical minerals (copper, nickel, lithium, potash, prospective rare earths), plus institutional alignment, create a differentiated opportunity in data centers, sovereign compute, grid investment, mineral processing and allied supply chains for the global compute cycle.

The combination of electricity, uranium, critical minerals and institutional alignment creates a differentiated opportunity in data centers, sovereign compute, grid investment, mineral processing and allied supply chains.

Canadian power generators, uranium and critical-mineral producers and processors could see rising demand from AI/compute buildout; the article does not quantify revenue or earnings effects or name companies.
